title: Keep wagon manifests and feature files cross-referenced both ways

facts.note: Presence of either a wagon manifest (features[] list) or a feature YAML file in the plan tree is enough; both need not exist.
Any authoring, editing or inspection of plan artifacts containing feature files or wagon features[] entries; the invariant holds continuously, not only on structural edits.
Diff-level observer that highlights the most likely moment a gap is introduced; not required for firing.
Validator failures from the two coverage validators; an additional trigger, not the only one.

fires: Planner adds a new feature YAML file without adding it to its wagon manifest's features[] list.
Planner adds a features[] entry pointing to a feature YAML file that does not exist.
Planner renames or deletes a feature file, leaving a stale features[] entry.
Planner edits or reviews a plan where a pre-existing feature file is not referenced by its wagon manifest, even with no structural edit and no validator run yet.
Planner inspects a wagon manifest (including one whose wagon has no feature files) containing a dangling features[] entry, with no current structural edit or validator finding.
A feature file exists (not allow-listed) whose wagon manifest is missing or does not list it.
Coverage validator reports an unreferenced feature or a dangling wagon features[] reference.
doesNotFire: Feature file is listed in the features_orphaned allow-list (feature -> wagon direction only).
Edits to train <-> wagon references only (covered by the train-level coverage convention).
Content-only edits to a feature file when every feature file is already listed by its wagon and every features[] entry already resolves.

given: The plan contains feature YAML files and/or wagon manifests with features[] entries.
when: The planner authors, edits, moves, deletes or reviews any of them.
then: Every feature file is referenced by its wagon manifest's features[], and every features[] entry resolves to an existing feature YAML file.
prefer: Update features[] in the same change that adds, renames or removes a feature file.
Record an intentionally wagon-less feature in the features_orphaned allow-list instead of leaving it silently unreferenced.
avoid: A feature file no wagon manifest lists (feature -> wagon gap).
A features[] entry pointing to a missing, renamed or deleted feature file (wagon -> feature gap).
Allow-listing features that belong to a wagon just to silence the validator.
unless: The feature is on the features_orphaned allow-list (exempts only feature -> wagon; features[] entries must still resolve).
why: Coverage means each feature is referenced by its wagon and vice versa; a one-sided link leaves untracked features or dangling references, breaking plan traceability.
evidence: test_all_features_in_wagon_manifest passes: every feature file is referenced by its wagon manifest (excluding features_orphaned allow-list entries).
test_all_wagon_feature_refs_exist passes: every wagon features[] entry has a corresponding feature YAML file.
verifier_detail: Direction feature -> wagon: every feature file must be referenced by its wagon manifest; exceptions: features_orphaned allow-list; validator: test_all_features_in_wagon_manifest.
Direction wagon -> feature: every features[] entry must have a corresponding YAML file; no exceptions authored; validator: test_all_wagon_feature_refs_exist.
Term wagon_feature_coverage: each feature is referenced by its wagon and vice versa.
